value: At the summit, Drakuru displays the next work of his reign: Blightblood Trolls, made from captured Drakkari chieftains and infused with blight. He calls them the first of a greater army, meant to sweep across Zul’Drak. The captives who once stood among their own people have been turned into instruments against them. Before the display can become a campaign, the infiltrator’s disguise fails. Drakuru recognizes the deceit, and the necropolis becomes a place of open reckoning.
editorNote: Research status: quest mirrors support the paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review are still required. The prisoner bargain, claimed artifact history, faction/follow-up variants, invasion chronology and motives are not expanded beyond their cited scope.
